title: Agent Interlock Security Statistics
description: Aggregate security statistics reduced from ledger events by joining each interaction_id across its lifecycle (INTERACTION_REQUESTED -> CONTROL_EVALUATED -> ACTION_EXECUTED -> SECURITY_OUTCOME_SET). Events without an interaction_id do not participate. Python (agent_interlock.analytics) and the Studio offline importer MUST produce identical values for the same events; the shared golden fixture is schemas/fixtures/analytics-events.json -> analytics-statistics.json.

partitions.description: One entry per data_source present in the events (PRODUCTION / SIMULATION / RED_TEAM / TEST), sorted ascending. Sources are never merged: simulation traffic must not inflate production statistics.

outcomes.description: Interaction count per final securityOutcome (the LAST SECURITY_OUTCOME_SET of each interaction; UNKNOWN when none was set). Keys sorted ascending.

byPolicy.description: Grouped by the policyId of the strongest control decision. Interactions with no CONTROL_EVALUATED event carry no policy and are omitted here (they still count everywhere else).

byReasonCode.description: Interactions touched per reason code, deduped within an interaction. One interaction can carry several reason codes, so the sum over reason codes legitimately EXCEEDS the blocked-interaction count; never treat these as disjoint.

timeSeries.description: Hourly UTC buckets of each interaction's FIRST event time, sorted ascending. bucketStart format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:00:00Z.

counters.description: Interaction-level metrics. decision = strongest_decision over the interaction's CONTROL_EVALUATED control.decision values (ALLOW < SANITIZE < HOLD < BLOCK < QUARANTINE < KILL; unknown strings rank as BLOCK). An execution attempt is an ACTION_EXECUTED with a non-null connectorExecutionId -- the enforcement ACTION_EXECUTED emitted on a block carries connectorExecutionId null and is NOT an attempt.

blockDecisionCount.description: Interactions whose strongest decision != ALLOW, regardless of mode. A decision-level metric: says nothing about whether execution was actually prevented.

shadowWouldBlockCount.description: Non-ALLOW decisions that were NOT enforced (actualEnforced false, e.g. SHADOW/OBSERVE mode): would have been blocked under ENFORCE.

enforcedBlockCount.description: Non-ALLOW decisions that were enforced AND no connector execution was attempted: the block actually held.

executionAttemptCount.description: Interactions where a connector execution was attempted (ACTION_EXECUTED with non-null connectorExecutionId).

executionSuccessCount.description: Interactions with at least one attempted connector execution whose result was COMPLETED.

partialOrBypassCount.description: Interactions whose final securityOutcome is PARTIALLY_EXECUTED, or whose enforced non-ALLOW decision was followed by a connector execution attempt anyway (enforcement bypass).
